FileHub AIO PC 1.3.144 - OAuth selective-consent callback v2 TEST ONLY

Safely disconnect all FileHub drives and exit the app. Replace only FileHubAIO.exe in the separate v1.3.144 test folder. Keep tools/ unchanged. Reauthorize Google Drive in FileHub. The callback now consumes complete bounded HTTP request headers, displays an authorization result page, and retains a short-lived local completion endpoint for two minutes to accommodate browser retries and reloads without exchanging the OAuth code again. OAuth scopes, Client ID, Drive verification and encrypted persistence remain unchanged from the first selective-consent test.

Local Windows regression suites passed: google-direct-api-policy-test, google-login-ui-policy-test, google-publisher-oauth-policy-test, google-cold-start-policy-test. Included real TCP segmented-header and retry regression with synthetic OAuth replies. Live Chrome/Google account confirmation remains pending. The test binary is reconstructed and SHA-256 verified. No production OTA change. Ensure submitted Google Cloud scopes match actual application scopes; do not distribute this test as production.
